text:
Sympathetic innervation of the colon originates from preganglionic neurons in the thoracolumbar spinal cord, roughly T10–L2, not from S2–S4 or L3–L5. The shared note's options don't match: S2–S4 is the parasympathetic (pelvic splanchnic) outflow to the distal colon, and L3–L5 isn't a sympathetic source for these viscera.

CONFIDENCE: 75
